items.signal_prefix: Open Platform Business Group (Co-CEO Samson Hu): Q2 revenue

set.signal: Open Platform Business Group (Co-CEO Samson Hu): Q2 revenue declined approximately 10%-15% YoY on key component cost headwinds, as memory price hikes hurt end demand for motherboards and graphics cards; ROG monitors grew 20% and accessories over 50% YoY, and NUC revenue rose 30% driven by the NVIDIA-branded Ascent GX10 (the GX10 launched in Q4 of last year; Q2 shipments were 3 times those of the first quarter). He sees memory price increases slowing but still rising in the second half and believes boards and cards can gradually return to growth.
